Name: GreenHouse Upgrades 5 Levels (Beta Tester) Works with Android
Author: FERNASS354
Description:
[b]Mod Update Notes:

Version 1.7:

We are excited to bring you new Version of our mod, packed with improvements and fixes based on the invaluable contribution of user  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/57627456]Fullbanner
[/url]invested significant time in uncovering both parts and the complete issue, allowing us to pinpoint and correct the error. Thanks to the dedicated efforts [b]
[/b]
 Here's what's new:

[list]
[*]Greenhouse Digging Issue Resolved: we have identified and addressed the problem preventing users from excavating in the greenhouse.
[/list][list]
[*]Product Aging on Map: An exciting addition to this update is the introduction of product aging on the map. Now, you can utilize the warehouse to age your products, enhancing the gameplay experience.
[/list][list]
[*]Streamlined Resource Requests: We've reworked the supply requirements for Robin the carpenter's upgrades. Now, she will ask for fewer resources, making the upgrade process more accessible. Additionally, these resource requests should now be visible to all players, with only four objects requested for each upgrade.
[/list]

Note: This update is tailored for Version 1.7, which is already available.
As always, your feedback is invaluable to us. We hope you enjoy these enhancements and a smoother gaming experience. Happy farming!

Version 1.6:

Adjusted prices 35% less

Version 1.5:

Compatible with Android

We're thrilled to release version 1.5 of our mod! In this update, we've successfully fixed the bug preventing players from planting on tilled soil tiles. We've also introduced Level 3, broadening your gameplay possibilities. All known issues seem to be resolved, ensuring a seamless farming adventure. One of the standout features in this release is a door we've added to the greenhouse's glass pane. This door leads to a dedicated area for planting resin trees. We value your feedback and hope you appreciate these enhancements. As always, happy farming!

This model allows you to upgrade the greenhouse to 5 different levels, has an automatic irrigation system, crops and fruit trees can be moved within the greenhouse and more improvements. 
Winery is added, crop space is expanded and new areas are added, You can upgrade it with robin like any other building


This mod is in development, only levels 1 and 2 are available, the other levels are not implemented


They can suggest the design of the greenhouse as well as what expands and so on, everything in general will be taken into account in order to improve the mod.

as well as the costs and materials for its construction

Please support your game to try this mod, since as it is a beta the mod can make big changes in its final version, it is only to test it and comment on what you would like to implement in the mod in the future.

To activate and deactivate the collection of trees and crops, it is done from the generic menu before entering your game.
